title: 2026 VET and TAS task sources
scope: All 61 VET definitions and 60 TAS definitions plus five weekly review controls currently loaded in the app. This is a complete inventory of loaded entries, not a claim that every possible school obligation is present. Compound tasks may contain several milestones; recurring duties are listed once with their trigger. Personal notes, individual learner records and saved completion data are excluded.
method: A specific citation identifies a traceable origin or date; it does not certify that every part of the task or an older local instruction is current. Source records include named documents, document families awaiting originals, live portals and local design controls; those types are counted separately. Recommendations for checking frequency are not official release promises.
